etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Ancient Greek μῑσογύνης (mīsogúnēs), from μῑσέω (mīséō, “I hate”) + γυνή (gunḗ, “woman”), equivalent to misogyny +‎ -ist.
senses: One who professes misogyny; a person who hates or is prejudiced against women.
Misogynistic; relating to or exhibiting misogyny.
